title: Ariel School witnesses reunite in Los Angeles

tellings.quote: they all just agreed for the first time ever to get back together after 20 years of the case The Landing case in Ru Zimbabwe

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker who investigates UFOs, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about the Ariel School case, in which a group of schoolchildren in Ruwa, Zimbabwe said they saw a craft land near their school. He says that in 2013, about twenty years later, the former pupils agreed for the first time to get back together, meeting in Los Angeles, which matters because it let the witnesses retell their story as adults.
